title: Restricted monodromy containing transpositions
summary: We relate the monodromy group of a branched cover to the monodromy groups of its restrictions. We show that the presence of a transposition in a restricted monodromy group significantly constrains the monodromy group of the original branched cover. Using this result, we complete the sparse trace test algorithm, which numerically verifies whether a set of solutions to a sparse polynomial system is complete. Along the way, we develop a generalization of the notion of a trace test in the setting of branched covers.
